items.title: Show HN: Serve Nix closures to k8s pods
items.contentSnippet:
I’ve been working on a Nix CSI for kubernetes since NixCon when I realized that everyone seems to working towards killing OCI layers (and images) in Kubernetes deployments.
I’m hoping to get people to give it a spin and report back to me bugs, feature requests or general feedback. I don’t have a lot of data on how this scales and that makes it hard to decide whether to justify adding a feature or not (e.g. cache locality scheduling).
An LLM was used in the development of this project.

items.title: Show HN: Ayafy: A free app to memorise and revise the Quran
items.contentSnippet:
I built Ayafy, a free Quran learning app on iOS and Android. It lets you manage memorisation, automatically prepares revision tests as you study, measure progress, establish goals and review your recitation with AI-powered word-by-word feedback. It has also a quran reader, voice search and much more.
I would love to hear your open feedback & ideas for improvements!
Website: https://ayafy.com
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ayafy/id1549129832
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details

items.title: Show HN: Task629 – Personal development tracking through task descriptions
items.contentSnippet:
I built Task629 to make the tracking of my personal development less time consuming. Instead of spending time thinking about how the tasks which I have completed fit into certain skills I am trying to develop, I pass this to a locally hosted AI.
As well as tracking individual skills which are demonstrated by tasks, there is functionality to work towards goals and to produce a report. This addition makes interview prep much simpler.
Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50134197

items.title: Show HN: Halal Crypto Index – AAOIFI Shariah compliance screener for 800 coins
items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN,
We built Halal Crypto Index (https://halalcryptoindex.com) to provide transparent, open-methodology Shariah screening for 820+ crypto assets based on AAOIFI financial ratios (debt/market cap, interest revenue, utility vs speculation).
Ecosystem:
• Live Web App: https://halalcryptoindex.com
• Telegram Mini App: https://t.me/Halal_Crypto_App_Bot/app
• MCP AI Server: https://smithery.ai/servers/tffsgsff/halal-crypto
• CERN Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23021995
